To my love Abi

Pull the letter up, or tap to open.

To my love Abi

Every time you're I call you when you're sleep, when you answer, you make like a baby noise, almost like you want to be babied by me in that moment, and its the small things like that, that are just so cute to mean. And it's the small things like that I remember without even realizing it, because I love you so much. Hearing your voice and your winning and you laughs and just your presence and just make smile and fills my heart with so much love and joy.

I remember the first time we hung out at Whataburger and how I enjoyed it, but I was slightly nervous, but also was a little unsure, mainly because I didn't know much about your personality, and I didn't think you'd act like the you I know now, so I probably was also a little awkward. Who would've known our 2 failed first dates and our one Whataburger date would lead to all of this, of us going to prom, then graduation, and our movie dates or time at the mall, to smash room and go karting and wingstop and all the other things I didn't mention.

Whenever we're having a discussion or you do something sometime, I can't help but think, how did I get so lucky to have you choose someone like me, which is why I always try so hard and beat myself up so I can be the partner that you deserve. I love the way that your so understanding and shortcoming or problem I have or all the things I need learn or should have, and all my shortcomings or failures, you never put me down or judge me and make me feel bad. You always say the things to encourage me and lift me up to help me keep going, and you choose to stay by my side, even when I think you shouldn't or you don't have to.

I always think about you being my future and our future being so amazing, and when I'm alone, I sometimes think about all the things I want to do and try with you, big or small, that'll make my life so much more meaningful and fulfilling.

Forever your Rere ♡
